page.overview:
Who is 391 (LMD)?

When MODOK did not immediately respond, 391 asked whether he intended to retreat to safety, noting that many of New York's protectors were engaged in the fighting in Washington, D.C., and estimating that Manhattan would fall within approximately 2.3 hours. MODOK instead ordered his LMDs to target his position with laser rifles and immediately release Zzzax, making clear that he intended to remain in the fight.
